mapper.sql: s.id, s.status, s.create_time, st.id AS student_id, st.student_no, u.real_name AS student_name, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.code AS c_code, c.credits AS c_credits, c.hours AS c_hours, c.type AS c_type, c.description AS c_description, t.id AS c_teacher_id, tu.real_name AS c_teacher_name, c.semester AS c_semester, c.schedule AS c_schedule, c.classroom AS c_classroom, c.max_students AS c_max_students, c.current_students AS c_current_students, c.create_time AS c_create_time

FROM course_selection s JOIN student st ON st.id = s.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = st.user_id JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = t.user_id
